description: This file provides helper functions for discovering and resolving gateway services, including constructing URLs and SSH targets based on a GatewayDiscoveryModel. It contains static utility functions used for network service resolution and URL formation in the context of gateway discovery.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Resolves and trims the service host string from a GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway object.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a given host string and returns it if not empty.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs a tuple of host and port if the gateway's service host and port are valid.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs a tuple of host and port from given host and port strings, validating the port range.

methods.name: sshTarget
methods.description: Generates an SSH target string for connecting to the gateway, including user and port.

methods.name: directUrl
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket URL for direct gateway access.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl
methods.description: Constructs a secure (wss) or insecure (ws) URL for the given gateway host and port, preferring TLS for non-loopback hosts.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Utility function to trim whitespace and newlines from a host string.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if a host string refers to a loopback address, including localhost, IPv6 loopback, and 127.x addresses.
